name: hackelite
description: HackElite: live hackathons ranked for you, with a resume-aware recommendation engine, per-event AI agent, calendar sync, and teams with live private chat.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:db" "wait-on -t 900000 tcp:127.0.0.1:27017 && npm run api" "wait-on -t 900000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5050 && npm run web"
scripts.dev:nodb: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,magenta "npm run api" "wait-on -t 60000 tcp:127.0.0.1:5050 && npm run web"
scripts.audit: npm --prefix server audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build && npm run e2e
